dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High-contrast white spots/bars create sharp boundaries against the dark brownish-black ground of the folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Bright red triangular patch on the posterior nape/hindneck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct transition from a uniform grey crown to a brownish-grey barred mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Vivid red crescent on the upper nape is the most prominent monochromatic feature.
